scope: Externally supplied reference implementations independently rerun and reviewed. Numerical cross-verification only; not experimental validation.

adaptations.twoDimensional: Original root equations and samples retained; pressure checking made mandatory with zero allowance, separate strict admission adapter, UI progress/cancel and compatibility. Core0.3.2 bytes unchanged.
adaptations.axisymmetric: JavaScript port of continuous linear-vortex Python equations; finite input/resource bounds, geometry guards, explicit convergence flags, progress/cancel and independent direct-field diagnostics. Nodal reconstruction is labelled.
adaptations.noQualificationRelaxation: Unchanged physical pressure screen and prior off-grid thresholds; unresolved local errors and stalled iterations retained.

releaseTextEncoding: UTF-8, LF. Immutable received archive is separately retained with original hashes.
